_comment: DEFAULT CONFIGURATION - All sensors visible, no filtering
_comment2: Copy this file to config.json to restore defaults
_comment3: Or use as reference when customizing config.json

defaultTimeRange._comment: Initial time range when page loads. Options: '5m', '1h', '3h', '6h', '12h', '24h'

colors._comment: Chart line colors (hex format). Cycles through if more sensors than colors

zoom._comment: Zoom and pan behavior (wheel, drag, pinch)

sensorFilter._comment: Filter which sensors to display. Set enabled=true to filter, false to show all
sensorFilter._comment2: includePatterns: array of strings/regex patterns. Sensor name must match at least one pattern
sensorFilter._comment3: Example: ['Core'] shows only CPU cores, ['acpitz'] shows ACPI thermal zone, ['Core', 'acpitz'] shows both
